locationEn: 4F, Building 5, No. 50 Huatuo Road, Daxing District, Beijing, China
missionEn: Guarding women's health through innovative epigenetic technology
descriptionEn: Founded in 2020 and headquartered in the Beijing Daxing Biomedical Industry Base, CISPOLY is a technology-driven enterprise dedicated to advancing health through innovation. As a pioneer in early screening and diagnosis of gynecologic cancers, CISPOLY is a certified National and Zhongguancun High-Tech Enterprise, focusing on the R&D, manufacturing, and commercialization of early screening and diagnostic products for women's cancers and related diseases, along with automated testing equipment.

milestonesEn.text: CISPOLY founded, headquartered in the Beijing Daxing Biomedical Industry Base
CISENDO® received NMPA registration — the world's first non-invasive endometrial cancer screening launched
CISOVA® received NMPA registration — China's first ovarian cancer methylation test launched; recognized as a Beijing SRDI (Specialized, Refined, Differential, Innovative) Enterprise

qualificationsEn: Beijing SRDI (Specialized, Refined, Differential, Innovative) Enterprise
ISO 13485 Medical Device Quality Management System
